english: This brings us to our second point from before—a description of the fine qualities of the forces. Here we cover four topics: a brief presentation of the ten forces; a more extensive explanation of the same; a discussion of how it would be impossible ever to describe all these fine qualities; and a demonstration of the benefits of understanding the two kinds of fine qualities. Here is the first.
